intro: This zone is the city's oldest layer, older than the planned sectors around it. Old Faridabad is the historic town core, and NIT, the New Industrial Township, was built from 1949 by families displaced by Partition and became a working industrial town within a few years. Its numbered parts, NIT 1, 2, 3 and 5, are dense lanes of independent houses, builder floors and plots, with long-established markets and workshops in between. Jawahar Colony sits by the railway line, and Dabua Colony, inside Sector 50, is an affordable colony around its own sabzi mandi. Gated complexes are almost absent.

For tuition, that means doorstep visits on tight streets. A tutor rarely needs a gate pass here, yet can lose time looking for parking near a market or picking the right lane among several that look the same. Bata Chowk and Neelam Chowk Ajronda on the Violet Line sit at NIT's edges, Old Faridabad station stands in Sector 16A, and Faridabad railway station is in Sector 20A, so a tutor coming by metro or train finishes with a short auto ride. The evening market crowd and the railway crossing near Jawahar Colony are the main delays, which is why after-school or weekend-morning slots hold up well.

NXTutors fills an NIT or Old Faridabad request from the inside out: tutors living in these colonies first, then those who already travel to them, then tutors from elsewhere in Faridabad, and online teachers only if no one within reach covers the subject. You see two or three matched tutors, each with a fee on the profile before any class. The first class is a free demo at home, and a switch to someone else later is free. Mention your NIT part or colony and a nearby market in the request, because addresses in these older lanes are much easier to find with a landmark.
faqs: Do tutors need a gate pass in NIT or Old Faridabad?

Almost never. Homes are independent houses and builder floors on old lanes, so the tutor comes straight to the door. The difficulty is finding it the first time: send the NIT part or colony, the house number and a landmark, and warn the tutor that parking near the markets is scarce.
Which metro is nearest for Dabua Colony and Jawahar Colony?

Neelam Chowk Ajronda on the Violet Line is among the nearer stations for Dabua Colony, which lies in Sector 50, and the Mathura Road stations are a short auto ride from Jawahar Colony. In both cases the last stretch is by auto, and a two-wheeler is handier than a car in the lanes.
Why do after-school slots work better in NIT?

Market roads in NIT and Old Faridabad fill up as the evening goes on, and crossing Mathura Road or the railway line near Jawahar Colony can be slow at the rush. A class that starts soon after school, or on a weekend morning, avoids both and is easier to keep every week.
How are tutors chosen for an NIT request?

By distance first. NXTutors lists tutors who live in the NIT and Old Faridabad colonies, then those who travel there, then others in Faridabad, then online tutors. You receive two or three, see each fee before the demo, and take a free first class with each before deciding whom to continue with.

intro: The central sectors are the planned HSVP grid along Mathura Road, from Sectors 7, 8 and 9 in the south up through 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 15A, 16, 16A, 17, 18 and 19, with the Sector 21 pockets and 21C stretching towards Badkhal. The typical home is a plotted house or builder floor on a broad internal road, with a few apartment buildings and gated societies. There is real variety within that: Sector 17 has villas on green roads, Sector 19 is largely rented builder floors, Sector 10 is mainly the Housing Board Colony, and Sector 12 holds the state sports complex and a large town park beside its homes.

This is the zone where the metro does most of the work. Violet Line stations stand inside or beside several sectors, Neelam Chowk Ajronda in 15A, Old Faridabad in 16A, Bata Chowk in 12 and Badkhal Mor next to 19, while Escorts Mujesar and Sihi serve the southern end. A tutor from Delhi or Ballabhgarh can therefore reach much of the zone without a car, walking or taking a short auto from the platform. Mathura Road itself, the Badkhal flyover and the markets in Sectors 15 and 16 are what slow things down, mostly in the evening, so an after-school start avoids the worst of it.

For the central sectors, NXTutors looks first for tutors in your own or a neighbouring sector, then for tutors who travel to this stretch of Mathura Road, then across Faridabad, and after that online. With a metro line running through the zone, a tutor living a few stations away can appear in the second group. You get two or three tutors to compare, each fee on view before the demo, which is free. If you want a change later, the switch is free. Give the sector when you ask, and in Sector 10 add the block and pocket, since lanes there look alike.
faqs: Which central sectors are close to a metro station?

Several have one inside or beside them: Neelam Chowk Ajronda is in Sector 15A, Old Faridabad in 16A, Bata Chowk in Sector 12 and Badkhal Mor next to Sector 19. Escorts Mujesar and Sihi serve the sectors around 7 to 11. Tutors coming by Violet Line finish on foot or by a short auto.
Are the central sectors mostly houses or apartments?

Mostly houses and builder floors on plotted streets, which means doorstep visits and easier parking. A few apartment buildings and gated societies exist, for example in Sectors 12, 17 and 21C, where the tutor's name should go to security. Sector 10's Housing Board Colony has lettered blocks and pockets that look alike.
When is Mathura Road easiest for a visiting tutor?

Before the evening rush. Mathura Road, the Badkhal flyover and the busy markets in Sectors 15 and 16 load up after office hours, so a lesson fixed for straight after school, or for Saturday and Sunday mornings, is the easiest to hold each week. Tutors arriving by metro are less affected by the road.
What does a home tutor in central Faridabad charge?

It depends on the tutor, the class and the subject, and you see the fee on each profile before the demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: These northern sectors sit between central Faridabad and the Delhi border. Sector 28 is an HSVP sector whose older plotted houses have largely been rebuilt as three- and four-bedroom builder floors, with a HUDA market for daily shopping. Sector 29 next door adds some flats in gated societies. Part of Sector 30 is the Police Lines, with residential pockets of flats and floors around it and colonies such as Indraprastha Colony nearby. Sector 31 mixes homes with shops and offices along Mathura Road, and Sector 37, on the border edge near the Sehatpur village area, is green and mostly residential, with houses, floors and some apartments.

Every sector here has a Violet Line station close by: Sector 28 has its own, Mewla Maharajpur stands inside Sector 31, and Sarai, NHPC Chowk and Badkhal Mor are within reach. That widens the choice of tutor, because someone living in south Delhi can arrive by train and skip the queues at the border crossing on Mathura Road. Builder floors in Sector 28 may have a shared door and intercom, so the tutor needs the floor and the right bell, while the societies in Sector 29 want a name at the gate. Late-afternoon slots, or ones after the evening rush has cleared, avoid the office traffic.

NXTutors starts a search for these sectors with tutors living in Sectors 28 to 31 or 37, moves on to tutors who list them as places they travel to, which can include tutors from the Delhi side of the border, then the rest of Faridabad, then online. Two or three tutors are suggested; each shows a fee before the free demo, and switching later is free. Tell us whether you live in a plotted house, a builder floor or a society, so the tutor knows what to expect at the entrance and the first class is not delayed at a gate or a locked stairway.
faqs: Can a tutor from south Delhi teach in Sector 37 or Sector 28?

Yes, and the metro makes it realistic. Sarai station is nearest for Sector 37, with Badarpur Border also close, and Sector 28 has its own Violet Line stop. A tutor coming by train avoids the Mathura Road crossing at the border, which is slow at peak hours, and finishes with a short auto.
What is Sector 30 like for home tuition?

Part of Sector 30 is the Police Lines, with quarters, a parade ground and offices, so some of it is institutional. Around it are residential pockets of flats and builder floors, reached at the doorstep. A clear address and landmark are usually all a tutor needs, and Sector 28 or Mewla Maharajpur is the nearest station.
Do builder floors in Sector 28 need anything special for a tutor?

Just clear instructions at the entrance. Many older houses in Sector 28 were rebuilt as three- and four-bedroom builder floors, and some share a single entrance with an intercom. Tell the tutor your floor and which button to press; there is normally no visitor register of the kind a society keeps.
Can we try online lessons instead of home visits?

Yes. You can ask for home lessons, online lessons or a mix, depending on what the tutor offers, and the free first demo can take either form. Fees appear on each profile before the demo, NXTutors suggests two or three tutors to compare, and if you later want a different one, switching is free.

intro: This is the part of Faridabad that climbs towards the Aravalli hills. It takes in Sector 43 on the Surajkund–Badkhal Road, the quieter Sectors 45 and 46, older Sector 48, Sainik Colony in Sector 49 along with Aravali Vihar, and Charmwood Village near Surajkund and the Delhi border. Housing is more mixed than in the plotted centre of the city: group-housing flats and builder floors in Sector 43, apartment complexes beside plotted houses in 45 and 46, mostly independent houses and floors in Sector 48 and Sainik Colony, and apartments and villas behind guarded gates in the Charmwood township. Badkhal Lake and green belts sit close by.

No metro climbs the hill, so the last leg decides whether a tutor arrives on time. Tutors coming by Violet Line use Sector 28, NHPC Chowk, Mewla Maharajpur, Badkhal Mor or Bata Chowk and take an auto up; for Charmwood, Badarpur Border and Tughlakabad on the Delhi side are nearer. Many simply ride a two-wheeler. The Surajkund–Badkhal Road is busy when schools open and close, the Gurugram–Faridabad road carries through traffic, and the crafts mela each February crowds the Surajkund side, so a slightly later slot, and plans for online lessons during the mela, keep the routine steady.

NXTutors handles a request from this zone by listing tutors who live in these sectors and colonies first, then tutors who have said they travel to Surajkund, Sainik Colony or Charmwood, then the rest of Faridabad, then online. Since the metro is some way off, tutors in the first two groups usually keep time more reliably than someone crossing the city. You get two or three to compare, fees visible on their profiles, a free first class, and free switching if the fit changes later. Share whether you live in a society, a villa enclave or an independent house when you book.
faqs: Which station should a tutor use for Charmwood Village?

Badarpur Border and Tughlakabad on the Violet Line, on the Delhi side, are the nearest, followed by an auto, cab or the tutor's own vehicle. Apartment blocks and villa enclaves in Charmwood have guarded gates, so register the tutor with security before the first class to avoid a wait at the entrance.
Is Sainik Colony mostly independent houses?

Largely, yes. Sainik Colony in Sector 49 was settled mainly by ex-servicemen and their families and is a planned colony of independent houses, builder floors and plots, with a few apartment blocks. Most visits are straight to the door. Metro stations are some distance away, so tutors usually come by auto or two-wheeler.
How does the Surajkund crafts mela affect tuition?

The mela is held every February, and traffic around Surajkund builds up while it runs. Families in Charmwood Village and the sectors along the Surajkund–Badkhal Road often move lessons online on those days rather than have a tutor stuck on the road, then return to home visits afterwards.
What happens if we want to change tutor?

Ask NXTutors and we suggest another; switching is free. Every request starts with two or three matched tutors, a free demo with each and fees shown on their profiles beforehand, so you can also go back to one of the other tutors you already met during the demos.

intro: At the southern end of the city, this zone joins old-town Ballabhgarh, founded in 1739 and now a tehsil of the district, to the HSVP sectors around it. The old colonies near the main market, such as Adarsh Nagar and Chawla Colony, have houses and small floors on narrow plots. Sectors 2, 3, 4 and 5 are settled plotted sectors; Sectors 22, 23 and 57 sit beside industrial areas, with Sanjay Colony in Sector 23 full of rented floors; Sectors 55 and 56 along the Ballabhgarh–Sohna Road are affordable and still developing; and Sectors 62, 64 and 65 mix plots, new floors, group housing and authority flats.

The Violet Line reached Ballabhgarh in November 2018, ending at a terminus beside Ballabhgarh railway station, with Sihi one stop before it and Escorts Mujesar further north. EMU trains also stop at Ballabhgarh, and the New Town railway halt is closer for Sectors 5 and 22. That gives tutors from central Faridabad a train ride and then an auto or e-rickshaw. Inside the old town, lanes are too tight for comfortable car parking, so a tutor on a two-wheeler is often simplest. Factory shift changes on the Sohna Road and around Sectors 22 and 57 are the timing issue to plan around.

For Ballabhgarh and the southern sectors, NXTutors ranks tutors living in your sector or colony first, then tutors who travel to this end of the city, then others across Faridabad, with online tutors after them. That order matters here, because a tutor who lives in Ballabhgarh reaches Sector 64 far more easily than one coming from the Delhi border. You are shown two or three tutors, each with the fee on the profile before the demo. The demo is free, and so is a change of tutor later. Add your sector or colony, and a landmark near the market if you live in the old town.
faqs: How do tutors reach Ballabhgarh by public transport?

By Violet Line to the Ballabhgarh terminus or to Sihi, or by EMU train to Ballabhgarh railway station, which sits beside the metro. After that, a shared auto or e-rickshaw carries them into the colonies and sectors. Tutors from the neighbouring sectors usually ride a two-wheeler instead.
Are the newer sectors near Ballabhgarh gated?

Partly. Sectors 62 and 65 have group-housing societies and authority flats where the tutor registers at the gate, alongside plotted houses with doorstep visits. Sectors 55, 56 and 64 are mostly plots, independent houses and newly built builder floors, with only a few group-housing projects among them.
Which roads slow tutors in the southern sectors?

The Ballabhgarh–Sohna Road and Mathura Road at shift changes and school hours, the market area in old Ballabhgarh in the evening, and the Faridabad Bypass Road at peak times. A fixed early-evening or weekend slot with a little buffer keeps weekly classes regular.
Is the fee agreed before the tutor visits?

Yes. Each tutor sets a fee and it appears on the profile, so you see it before booking the free demo class. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: The southern half of Neharpar, Sectors 75 to 80, is society country. Across the Agra canal from the old city, these sectors were planned for housing, and most families here live behind a gate: towers and some builder floors in Sector 75, society flats beside Neemka village in 76, large townships with one- to four-bedroom homes in 77, and mostly flats in 78 and 80. Sector 79 is the odd one out, with independent houses and low-rise buildings as well as societies, all around a large open-air street of shops, offices and restaurants. Tigaon Road and the Faridabad Bypass Road are the local spines.

The canal is the fact that shapes home tuition here. The Violet Line stays on the old-city side, so a tutor coming by metro gets off at Escorts Mujesar, Sihi or Bata Chowk and takes an auto or cab across; most others ride a two-wheeler or drive via the bypass, Tigaon Road or the DND–Faridabad–Sohna highway. The canal crossings and the roads around the Sector 79 street are slowest in the evening. Because families live close together in large societies, a tutor who teaches two or three children in the same sectors keeps travel light, and that is often the practical choice for a weekday class.

NXTutors searches for Sectors 75 to 80 in rings: tutors living in these sectors, then tutors who already cross the canal to teach here, then Faridabad as a whole, and online tutors after that. You see two or three matched tutors, each showing a fee before the free demo, and you can switch later without paying for it. As nearly every visit starts at a society gate, add the tower and flat number to the request, and pre-approve the tutor with security before the demo so the first class starts on time instead of at the visitor desk.
faqs: Is there a metro in Sectors 75 to 80?

No. The Violet Line runs on the old-city side of the Agra canal, so tutors who use it get off at Escorts Mujesar, Sihi or Bata Chowk and cross by auto or cab. Many tutors living in Greater Faridabad come by two-wheeler instead, which keeps evening timings steadier.
Which sectors in this zone have houses rather than societies?

Sector 79 has independent houses and low-rise buildings alongside its societies, Sector 76 has some plots, and Sector 75 has builder floors. Elsewhere, especially in Sectors 77, 78 and 80, society flats are the norm, and the tutor either registers at the gate each time or is pre-approved.
When is the Sector 79 area busiest?

Evenings and weekends, when the large shopping and dining street draws visitors from across Greater Faridabad. If you live nearby, ask the tutor to allow some extra time or pick a slot earlier in the afternoon, and keep an online session in reserve for the most crowded days.
How many tutors will we be offered?

Two or three. NXTutors matches each request with that many tutors, listing those who live closest first, then those who travel in. Each has a fee on the profile that you see before the free demo, and if you change your mind later, switching tutor is free.

intro: Sectors 81 to 89 form the northern half of Neharpar, and they hold a large share of its newer towers. Tall gated societies fill most of 81, 82 and 83, with low-cost housing projects in 82 and old villages like Bathola, Kheri Khurd and Budena at the edges. Sector 84 breaks the pattern: its lettered blocks each have a small market, and plots and houses sit beside flats. Sector 85 is largely builder apartments and budget societies, Sectors 86 and 87 combine societies with builder floors, plots and some houses, and Sector 89 has some of the most recently built societies, near Tikawali village. Most children here live in flats.

Kheri Road is the lifeline back across the Agra canal, and the sectors nearest that crossing, 86 and 87, are the easiest for a tutor from the old city to reach; Sector 87 looks across the water at Sectors 16 to 18. Neharpar has no station of its own, and the planned FNG expressway link is not open yet, so metro users leave the train at Neelam Chowk Ajronda, Bata Chowk, Old Faridabad or Badkhal Mor and continue by auto. In the evening, Kheri Road and the canal bridges clog, which makes a tutor who already lives in Neharpar the easier one to schedule on weekdays.

NXTutors fills requests from Sectors 81 to 89 nearest first: tutors who live in these sectors, then tutors who make the canal crossing to teach here, then the rest of Faridabad, and online tutors for anything no one within reach covers. You get two or three suggestions with their fees shown before the free demo, and you may switch tutor later at no cost. For families in tall towers, pairing home lessons with online sessions on busy days keeps the timetable realistic. Share your sector, society and tower, or the block letter if you live in Sector 84.
faqs: Which station is nearest to my sector in Neharpar's northern half?

None is inside Greater Faridabad. For the 81 to 84 group, Bata Chowk and Ajronda are the usual suggestions; for 85 to 87, Neelam Chowk Ajronda and Old Faridabad; for 88 and 89, Badkhal Mor and Bata Chowk. An auto or cab then carries the tutor across the Agra canal.
Is Sector 84 different from the tower sectors?

Yes. Sector 84 is arranged in lettered blocks, each with its own small market, and its plots and houses stand beside two- and three-bedroom flats. For a house, the block letter and number are enough for the tutor to walk up to you, while its societies ask for gate registration like the rest of the zone.
Why pick a tutor who already lives in Greater Faridabad?

Because the canal crossings on Kheri Road clog in the evening, a tutor coming from the old city can lose time on every visit. A tutor based in Neharpar avoids that, and in large societies one tutor may teach several nearby children, which keeps their schedule steady. NXTutors lists such tutors first.
Are tuition fees fixed by NXTutors?

No, each tutor sets their own fee, and it is shown on their profile before you book the free demo. Younger classes usually cost less than senior-school, international-board or entrance work. Two or three tutors are suggested, so you can compare fees and teaching before choosing, and switching later is free.
